subcategory_text: Governance and risk management policies, processes, and procedures address privacy risks.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-9, PM-11 (Information Security Governance)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.RR-01 (organisational leadership accountable)
implementation_examples: Integrate privacy risk into enterprise-wide governance, risk, and compliance processes so that privacy risks are visible at the same level as cyber, financial, and operational risks
Use consistent vocabulary, scoring scale, and reporting cadence across risk domains
Have privacy risks routinely reviewed at executive or board-level committees
assessment_objectives: Determine whether governance and risk management processes address privacy risks
Determine whether privacy risk reporting uses consistent vocabulary and cadence with other risk domains
Determine whether privacy risk escalations receive executive attention
Determine whether privacy risks are tracked in enterprise-wide GRC tooling
